latency_semantics: fixed-schedule padded native-device-command bounds; fused zero k-means, when selected, credits only the independently bounded public iteration-0 classification/write overlap
native_candidate_status: candidate pending the complete existing SE-PIM regression suite and the full publication matrix; not yet publishable native evidence

cpu_configuration.timing_label: direct restore into four TimingSimpleCPU system.cpu objects; no runtime CPU switch

scope: paired direct gem5 native-device-command interval: separate cleaning plus kmeans versus kmeans only; mean imputation remains a separate transparent clean phase; excludes file loading, protected-buffer staging, lock/unlock, guest validation, and result-copy time
case_isolation: every row restores the same checkpoint index; each off/cleaned pair uses checksum-pinned clean/dirty counterparts with an identical public shape; one byte-attestation-only atomic preflight restores the same checkpoint and hashes every exact guest input path before any TimingSimpleCPU evidence case is accepted

reserved_memory.validation: kernel command line, boot acknowledgement, and config verified

immutable_input_provenance.coverage: disk image, checkpoint sidecar and selected tree, gem5, guest workload, driver, host oracle, kernel, DTB, bootloader, dataset generator/wrapper, supplied generation manifest, and every selected clean/dirty/label/metadata artifact

docker_image_provenance: declared build/runtime image hint only; this runner does not attest which environment built the binaries, so executable artifact hashes are authoritative
source_diff_scope: top and nested IMPICA commits plus each repository's binary tracked diff against HEAD and sorted NUL-delimited untracked path list; Git status must also succeed and is recorded by digest; executable inputs are separately covered by source_tree_sha256 and artifact hashes

parameters.visible_action_semantics: device-reported public-geometry DMA actions of up to 128 KiB, not 64-byte submitted packet counts
parameters.submitted_packet_semantics: sum over DMA actions of ceil((physical_address mod 64 + action_bytes) / 64), reported separately for reads and writes
parameters.completion_cycle_semantics: exact sum of independently reconstructed fixed public clean and workload phase bounds

fixed_phase_bound_cycles.kmeans_scan_formula: per record-aligned chunk with R records: ceil((3*R*K*D + 2*R*D) / 16)
fixed_phase_bound_cycles.fused_zero_formula: bound = base + DMA action/packet allowances + scheduled k-means compute + serialized validation - overlap_credit; per chunk overlap_credit = min(classification_cycles, write_action_allowance + write_packet_allowance)

parameters.completion_observation: guest quiesces for the public total bound plus a public 1000 ns margin and performs exactly one completion STATUS read after the mandatory command-acceptance STATUS read
parameters.baseline_input: clean counterpart; cleaned zero/mean cases use the corresponding dirty file with an identical public shape

validation.property: for tested equal-shape secrets, device-reported FNV-1a-64 trace digests, aggregate action/packet/byte geometry, padded phase ticks, DMA bytes, and status reads are equal
validation.output_digest_treatment: declared kmeans output; checked against the independent functional reference but excluded from transcript equality
validation.guest_dataset_sha256_treatment: required to equal each case input_sha256, retained in native and paired rows, and excluded from secret-equality fields because it intentionally identifies the differing secret dataset bytes
validation.work_tick_delta_treatment: separate cleaning and mean-imputation rows require zero workload delta; fused zero k-means requires the exact independently reconstructed public iteration-0 validation/write-overlap delta
validation.trace_digest_validation: independently reconstructed standard FNV-1a-64 over each public (operation, physical address, byte count) tuple for sequential off/mean/fused traces and single-chunk separate-zero traces; multi-chunk pipelined separate-zero traces use exact aggregate action/packet/byte geometry plus FNV-1a-64 digest equality across tested equal-shape secrets because multiple public submission interleavings are legal. The digest is an error-detection commitment, not a collision-resistant proof of individual trace equality
